EU.name: European Union
EU.res: EU citizens can live, work and study here without a permit.
EU.biz: Single market: no customs or tariffs with the other 26 member states; one set of product rules.

EZ.name: Euro area
EZ.res: Pays in euro: no exchange cost or currency risk with 20 other euro countries.
EZ.biz: No currency risk in trade within the euro area; ECB interest rates.

SCH.name: Schengen area
SCH.res: No passport checks at borders with the other Schengen countries.
SCH.biz: Staff and goods cross internal borders without checks.

EEA.name: European Economic Area
EEA.res: EU and EEA citizens can live and work here.
EEA.biz: Full access to the EU single market for goods, services, capital and people.

EFTA.name: EFTA
EFTA.res: EFTA citizens can move freely among member states.
EFTA.biz: Free trade agreements with about 40 partners on top of national deals.

EUCU.name: EU customs union
EUCU.biz: Industrial goods move to and from the EU without tariffs.

EUC.name: EU candidate country
EUC.res: On the path to EU membership.
EUC.biz: EU accession talks: rules are being aligned with the EU.

NATO.name: NATO
NATO.res: Collective defence: an attack on one member counts as an attack on all.
NATO.biz: Part of the NATO security umbrella.

OECD.name: OECD
OECD.res: OECD statistics, schooling (PISA) and tax transparency standards apply.
OECD.biz: OECD investment, anti-bribery and tax rules (including the 15% global minimum tax).

G7.name: G7
G7.biz: One of the seven largest advanced economies.

BRICS.name: BRICS
BRICS.biz: Emerging-economy group with its own New Development Bank.

ASEAN.name: ASEAN
ASEAN.res: Visa-free short stays across ASEAN for ASEAN citizens.
ASEAN.biz: ASEAN Free Trade Area: almost no tariffs among ten member states.

USMCA.name: USMCA / CUSMA
USMCA.biz: Tariff-free trade across the United States, Mexico and Canada under rules of origin.

MERCOSUR.name: Mercosur
MERCOSUR.res: Mercosur residence agreement: nationals of member states can live and work here.
MERCOSUR.biz: Customs union with a common external tariff.

PA.name: Pacific Alliance
PA.biz: Free trade among Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru.

CPTPP.name: CPTPP
CPTPP.biz: Tariff cuts and digital trade rules with 11 Pacific partners and the UK.

RCEP.name: RCEP
RCEP.biz: The largest free trade area by population: ASEAN, China, Japan, Korea, Australia and New Zealand.

APEC.name: APEC
APEC.biz: Asia-Pacific forum; APEC Business Travel Card for faster entry.

GCC.name: Gulf Cooperation Council
GCC.res: GCC citizens can live and work in any member state.
GCC.biz: Gulf common market and customs union.

EAEU.name: Eurasian Economic Union
EAEU.res: Common labour market with Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan.
EAEU.biz: Customs union with the other members.

CW.name: Commonwealth
CW.res: Commonwealth ties: English-language law and education links.

AFCFTA.name: African Continental Free Trade Area
AFCFTA.biz: Tariffs are being removed across the African continent.

SACU.name: Southern African Customs Union
SACU.biz: Customs union with Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho and Namibia.
